faq.q: What is included in a Pride 2035 boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and an open bar with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light snacks are also provided. Spanish IVA (21%) is included in the price — no extra charges.

faq.q: How much does a Pride 2035 boat rental cost?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) cost €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and include a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a Pride party cruise?
faq.a: For a lively group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) offers deck space and a free jet ski. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 guests) has a spacious flybridge for dancing. Smaller groups can book the Fairline Targa (12m, 10 guests) or Bandido (11.5m, 8 guests).

faq.q: Can we bring our own music and decorations for Pride?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. All boats have Bluetooth speakers or AUX inputs. You are welcome to bring rainbow flags, banners, and decorations to personalise your charter. Just let us know in advance if you need extra power for sound systems.

faq.q: Where do Pride boat rentals depart from?
faq.a: All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. You can sail towards Marbella's Golden Mile, Cabopino, or further to Estepona. The skipper will tailor the route to your preferences, including stops for swimming near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a Pride charter?
faq.a: Most boats accommodate up to 12 guests, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, and Ferretti 94. Smaller vessels like the Dubhe (8m) take 5 guests, while the Mariah SX21 (6.4m) and Speedboat (7m) take 5–6. Check individual boat specs for exact capacity.

faq.q: Is the jet ski included for free on all rentals?
faq.a: No, the free jet ski is only included with Tier B boats: the Mangusta 80 (white or grey). For all other boats, jet skis can be added on request at an extra cost. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing.

faq.q: How do I book a Pride 2035 boat in Marbella?
faq.a: Send us a message on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send payment details. A deposit secures your booking. For Tier A and B boats, prices are fixed; for others, we'll provide a custom quote.

data.body_html:
Celebrate Pride 2035 in style with a luxury boat rental in Marbella. Whether you're planning a daytime party or a sunset cruise, our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and offers open-bar packages, licensed skippers, and stunning views of the Costa del Sol. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on a Tier A boat, or €4,719 for 4 hours on a Tier B boat with a free jet ski. No hidden fees — just you, your crew, and the Mediterranean.

Why Choose a Boat for Pride 2035 in Marbella?

Marbella's Pride celebrations are legendary, and a private boat charter adds an exclusive twist. Instead of crowded bars, you get a floating party with your own music, unlimited drinks, and a dedicated skipper. Sail along the Golden Mile, anchor near Cala del Faro for a swim, or watch the sunset over La Concha. With 12 guests max per boat, it's intimate yet lively — perfect for Pride.

Our Fleet for Pride 2035 Party Cruises

We offer 16 boats ranging from 6.4m speedboats to 29m superyachts. All depart from Puerto Banús. Here are the top picks for Pride:

  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) — Tier B, €4,719/4h, includes free jet ski. Spacious deck for dancing.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 guests) — Flybridge with panoramic views. Pricing on request.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) — Tier A, €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Great for smaller groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) — Tier A pricing. Comfortable and stylish.
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 guests) — Sporty cruiser. Pricing on request.
  • Bandido (11.5m, 8 guests) — Ideal for intimate Pride outings.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 guests) — Ultra-luxury. Pricing on request.

For a full list of boats and specs, visit our Marbella boat rental page.

What's Included in Your Pride Charter?

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and an open bar with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light snacks are provided. Spanish IVA (21%) is included in all prices — no surprises. You can bring your own decorations, music, and food if you wish.

Routes and Destinations from Puerto Banús

Your skipper can tailor the route. Popular options include:

  • Marbella Coast — Past the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha mountain.
  • Cabopino — Quiet coves and sandy beaches, about 30 minutes east.
  • Estepona — Charming town and marina, 20 minutes west.
  • Cala del Faro & Cala Cortés — Secluded swimming spots near Marbella.

All routes include stops for swimming, photos, and partying. Sunset cruises are especially popular for Pride.

Pricing Breakdown for Pride 2035

We keep it transparent:

Tier B includes a free jet ski. All prices include skipper, fuel, open bar, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

How to Book Your Pride 2035 Boat

Booking is simple. Contact us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll check availability and send a payment link. A deposit secures your slot. For Tier A and B boats, prices are fixed; for others, we'll provide a custom quote. Book early — Pride 2035 will be busy.
